stories.summary_en: The article argues that the tourism sector in Asia and the Pacific can lead efforts to address extreme heat through affordable measures, early warning systems, worker protection and climate-resilient planning. It presents the H.E.A.T. Framework as a practical approach. The early warning aspect is mentioned as one of several recommended measures.
